turns.question: What was the total ad spend on days when the email campaign had no booked lead, from 17 August to 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The email campaigns' ad spend on the days with no booking was 430 EUR: 43 days between 17 August and 2 October 2026 had no email booking (47 days in all, spend of 10 EUR a day; bookings fell on 21 August, 2 September, 14 September and 26 September). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
